concepts.description: The AUV system is developed as a Module.
A Robotic Platform is a platform component contained in a Module.
An Interface defines a set of interactions for components.
A Controller is a component that manages operations.
A Primitive Type represents a basic data type.
A Composite Type represents a structured data type composed of multiple values.
A Value is a data element contained in an Interface.
An Event is a signal defined in an Interface.
A Parameter is an input value passed to an Event.
A Return Value is a value returned by an Event.
A Function is an operation that computes an output from inputs.

instances.description: AUV_Module is the Module in which the AUV system is developed.
AUV_Platform is the Robotic Platform contained in AUV_Module.
Sensors is an Interface used by AUV_Platform.
Actuators is an Interface used by AUV_Platform.
AUV_Operator is the Controller contained in AUV_Module.
Inputs is the Interface used by AUV_Operator.
LRE_Ctrl is the Controller for the Last Response Engine contained in AUV_Module.
Outputs is an Interface used by LRE_Ctrl.
AUV_Autopilot is the Controller contained in AUV_Module.
nat is a Primitive Type for natural numbers.
int is a Primitive Type for integers.
string is a Primitive Type for string values.
boolean is a Primitive Type for boolean values.
real is a Primitive Type for real numbers.
SVec is a Composite Type that records a Spherical Vector.
Obstacle is a Composite Type that records obstacle values.
depth is a Value of type real in the Sensors Interface.
hdng is a Value of type SVec in the Sensors Interface.
obs is a Value of type Obstacle in the Sensors Interface.
Intpus is an Interface defined by AUV_Module.
endTask is an Event with no Parameters and no Return Value.
reqOCM is an Event with no Parameters and no Return Value.
reqMOM is an Event with no Parameters and no Return Value.
reqHCM is an Event with no Parameters and no Return Value.
reqVel is an Event with no Parameters and with a Return Value of type real.
reqHdng is an Event with no Parameters and with a Return Value of type real.
advVel is an Event that takes one Parameter of type real and has no Return Value.
advHdng is an Event that takes one Parameter of type real and has no Return Value.
Close is a Composite Type that records closure values.
odist is a Function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real.
hdist is a Function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real.
vdist is a Function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real.
